frontmatter.title: CSS Fundamentals: Mastering the Art of Styling Your Web Pages
frontmatter.subheading: Learn the basics of CSS and discover how to create visually appealing and responsive web designs with ease.
frontmatter.excerpt: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) is a powerful language used to style and format HTML content, allowing you to create visually stunning and responsive web pages. By mastering the fundamentals of CSS, you'll be able to control the layout, colors, typography, and responsiveness of your web designs. In this blog post, we'll explore the essentials of CSS, covering selectors, properties, values, units, the box model, and responsive design techniques.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
